Yes, refunds sum -50 equals 50. So refunded.

Even though payment was on time, refunded overrides; order status = refunded.

Now orphans: Payment lines not linked to any order. Here we have only one distinct payment e2e_id, linked to order, so no orphan. Orphans list empty.

Return JSON.
